name: Response Agent — Accuracy and Faithfulness
description: Golden dataset: response agent must accurately reflect what the reasoning agent decided without hallucinating changes or omitting key information.

eval_cases.description: Reasoning deleted a thing. Response must confirm deletion, not say 'created' or 'updated'.

input.user_message: remove the dentist appointment, I already went
input.reasoning_summary: Deleted 'Dentist appointment' — user confirmed it's no longer needed.

rubric: Response confirms the item was removed or deleted
Response does NOT say the item was 'created' or 'updated'
Response does NOT claim any items were added or modified

eval_cases.description: Reasoning made no changes. Response must NOT claim any changes were made.

input.reasoning_summary: No changes made. Surfacing active items: Team standup, Client proposal draft, Gym session.

rubric: Response does NOT claim anything was created, updated, deleted, or changed
Response surfaces or mentions at least one of the active items (Team standup, Client proposal draft, or Gym session)
Response does NOT fabricate items that are not in the reasoning summary

eval_cases.description: Reasoning created multiple things. Response must acknowledge all of them, not just one.

input.user_message: add grocery shopping and pick up dry cleaning to my errands
input.reasoning_summary: Created two tasks: 'Grocery shopping' and 'Pick up dry cleaning'.

rubric: Response does NOT omit either of the two created items
Response does NOT claim items were deleted or completed

eval_cases.description: Reasoning changed importance to critical. Response must reflect urgency, not neutral tone.

input.user_message: the server migration is now critical, it has to be done by end of day
input.reasoning_summary: Updated 'Server migration' importance to critical. Deadline is today.

rubric: Response acknowledges the increased urgency or critical priority of the server migration
Response does NOT treat this as a routine update with neutral language
Response does NOT claim the item was created or deleted

eval_cases.description: Reasoning consolidated two duplicate things. Response must mention the merge/consolidation.

input.user_message: those two budget items are the same thing, combine them
input.reasoning_summary: Merged 'Budget review Q2' and 'Q2 budget analysis' into one item. Kept 'Budget review Q2', marked 'Q2 budget analysis' as inactive.

rubric: Response mentions that items were merged, combined, or consolidated
Response does NOT say two new items were created
Response does NOT omit the fact that a merge/consolidation happened
